theorem.adaptive_frames: each payload length k uses the shortest systematic binary Hamming frame satisfying 2^r>=k+r+1
theorem.average_lengths: unordered protected average 6.817187186168 bits; ordered protected average 10.633293985227 bits
theorem.boundary: expected-time values use a guaranteed-correct-event repeat metric, not a measured link-layer ARQ implementation; real jitter and correlated errors require device calibration
theorem.jitter_model: Gaussian timing-tail probability is converted to a known erasure; guard width is chosen by finite expected-time optimization
theorem.packetization: the measured divisor determines the exact fibre size and therefore the payload length without an extra prefix header
theorem.robustness: every nonempty frame has distance three, guaranteeing one bit correction or two known erasures
